name: Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-4.3
description: 4.3" 480x800 MIPI-DSI panel (ST7701) with GT911 touch on an ESP32-P4, an ES8311 speaker codec, a TF card, a camera connector and Wi-Fi through its ESP32-C6. Compiled, not yet seen on a board.
verify: Nobody at LCD Wizard has had this board yet: the export for it compiles and has not been seen on the panel. Pins, the panel's start-up table and its settings are Waveshare's own, from their Arduino examples for this board and their ESP-IDF BSP, which agree: the ST7701 over MIPI-DSI under Waveshare's register table, two lanes at 500 Mbps, 30 MHz, hsync 12/42/42, vsync 8/2/60, the panel's reset on GPIO 27 (active low), and the backlight on GPIO 26, lit when the pin is low and dimmed by PWM. A design on this preset starts on revision 3 of the ESP32-P4, which Waveshare's own Arduino examples for the board build for; for a chip before revision 3 (the upload says "revision v1.x"), choose that under Hardware > Board > Chip revision. The GT911 has no reset or interrupt line driven and may answer at 0x14 instead of 0x5D. The TF card (SDMMC, 4-bit) and the ES8311 speaker codec (amplifier on GPIO 53) are in the kit, with the BOOT button (GPIO 35) and the battery voltage (GPIO 20, a third of the cell, from the schematic; no Waveshare code reads it). Wi-Fi is the ESP32-C6 beside the P4, on the ESP32 core's own SDIO lines (CLK 18, CMD 19, D0-D3 14-17, reset 54), which the schematic confirms; it has to run ESP-Hosted of the core's release, which the board prints at start (see the README). Not driven: the two ES7210 microphones and the C6's Bluetooth; the -C version's OV5647 camera is on the I2C bus at 0x36.
